Is Sort The Dumplings made with AI?

Yes. Sort The Dumplings discloses AI-generated content on Steam for art, according to its developer, Black Vault Games.

⚠️ Uses AI-generated content (disclosed)AI art & images

The developer describes how Sort The Dumplings uses AI-generated content like this:

Generative AI tools were used to assist in creating some pre-generated 3D models, textures, visual assets, and promotional artwork. All content is generated before gameplay, reviewed by the developer, and integrated into the finished game. No generative AI is used live during gameplay.

Developer: Black Vault Games · Released: Oct 28, 2026 · Checked 2026-11-03 · View on Steam
